license_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice certified public accountancy unless the person holds a Kansas certificate and a valid permit to practice issued by the board

issuing_authority.quote: The board shall provide for certification, notification and registration and issue permits to practice

name.quote: the Kansas board of accountancy established under K.S.A. 1-201

type.quote: the Kansas board of accountancy established under K.S.A. 1-201, and amendments thereto

moral_character_required.quote: The certificate of certified public accountant shall be known as the Kansas certificate and shall be granted by the board to any person of good moral character

degree_required.value: baccalaureate or higher academic degree with at least 150 semester hours, with a concentration in accounting
degree_required.quote: Is the holder of a baccalaureate or higher academic degree from a college or university approved by the board; (2) has been awarded credit by a college or university approved by the board for at least 150 semester hours, with a concentration in accounting

required.quote: No applicant who holds a Kansas certificate issued by the board shall receive a permit to practice in this state as a certified public accountant until the applicant submits evidence satisfactory to the board of having completed one year of accounting experience

duration.quote: completed one year of accounting experience

kind.value: accounting experience including attest or nonattest skills
kind.quote: This experience shall include providing any type of service or advice involving the use of attest or nonattest skills all of which was verified by a certified public accountant holding an active license to practice

exams.name: Uniform CPA Examination
exams.quote: has passed an examination in accounting and auditing and in such other related subjects as the board may determine to be appropriate

interval_years.quote: shall have a permit to practice issued or renewed on a biennial basis

required.quote: As a condition for renewal of a permit to practice, the board may require all permit holders to furnish with such applicant's renewal application, evidence of participation in continuing education in accounting, auditing, or related areas of at least 80 hours during the two-year period for renewal

hours_per_period.quote: at least 80 hours during the two-year period for renewal

period_years.quote: during the two-year period for renewal

available.quote: The board, in its discretion, may waive the examination of and may issue a certificate to a holder of a certificate as a "certified public accountant" issued under the laws of any state

requirements.value: Applicant must meet substantial equivalency standard or have passed examination with passing grades and meet current requirements, or have four years of experience within 10 years preceding application
requirements.quote: upon a showing that: (1) The applicant passed the examination required for issuance of the applicant's certificate with grades that would have been passing grades at the time in this state; and the applicant: (A) Meets all current requirements in this state for the issuance of a certificate at the time application is made; (B) at the time of the issuance of the applicant's certificate in the other state, met all such requirements then applicable in this state; or (C) had four years of experience of the type described in K.S.A. 1-302b(a), and amendments thereto, after passing the examination upon which the applicant's certificate was based and within the 10 years immediately preceding the application; or (2) the applicant meets the substantial equivalency standard

exists.quote: the Kansas board of accountancy established under K.S.A. 1-201, and amendments thereto

national_association.quote: "AICPA" means the American institute of certified public accountants

title_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person, except the holder of a valid certificate or practice privilege pursuant to K.S.A. 1-322, and amendments thereto, to use or assume the title "certified public accountant" or to use the abbreviation CPA

scope_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice certified public accountancy unless the person holds a Kansas certificate and a valid permit to practice issued by the board

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud, dishonesty or deceit in obtaining a certificate, permit, firm registration or practice privilege

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cancellation, revocation, suspension or refusal to renew a person's authority to practice for disciplinary reasons in any other jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: cancellation, revocation, suspension or refusal to renew a person's authority to practice for disciplinary reasons in any other jurisdiction for any cause

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain compliance with the requirements for issuance or renewal of permit, notification or practice privilege
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure, on the part of a holder of a permit to practice or practice privilege to maintain compliance with the requirements for issuance or renewal of such permit, notification or practice privilege

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sanction, censure, disciplinary action or revocation or suspension of the right to practice by the PCAOB or any state or federal agency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: sanction, censure, disciplinary action or revocation or suspension of the right to practice, by the PCAOB or any state or federal agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonesty, fraud or gross negligence in the practice of certified public accountancy
disciplinary_grounds.quote: dishonesty, fraud or gross negligence in the practice of certified public accountancy

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with applicable federal or state requirements regarding the timely filing of personal tax returns, firm tax returns or timely remittance of payroll and other taxes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to comply with applicable federal or state requirements regarding the timely filing of the person's personal tax returns, the tax returns of the person's firm or the timely remittance of payroll and other taxes collected on behalf of others

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of the act or rule and regulation of the board except for a violation of a rule of professional conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violation of any provision of this act or rule and regulation of the board except for a violation of a rule of professional conduct

disciplinary_grounds.quote: willful violation of a rule of professional conduct

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any order of the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violation of any order of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any felony, or of any crime an element of which is dishonesty, deceit or fraud
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conviction of any felony, or of any crime an element of which is dishonesty, deceit or fraud, under the laws of the United States, of Kansas or of any other state, if the acts involved would have constituted a crime under the laws of Kansas

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performance of any fraudulent act while holding a Kansas certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: performance of any fraudulent act while holding a Kansas certificate

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any false or misleading statement or verification in support of an application for a certificate, permit, notification or firm registration filed by another
disciplinary_grounds.quote: making any false or misleading statement or verification, in support of an application for a certificate, permit, notification or firm registration filed by another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to establish timely compliance with peer review
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to establish timely compliance with peer review pursuant to K.S.A. 1-501, and amendments thereto

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any conduct reflecting adversely on a person's fitness to practice certified public accountancy
disciplinary_grounds.quote: any conduct reflecting adversely on a person's fitness to practice certified public accountancy

definition_quote.value: "Practice of certified public accountancy" means performing or offering to perform attest or nonattest services for the public while using the designation "certified public accountant" or CPA in conjunction with such services
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of certified public accountancy" means performing or offering to perform attest or nonattest services for the public while using the designation "certified public accountant" or CPA in conjunction with such services

methods_authorized.quote: performing or offering to perform attest or nonattest services for the public

value: audits in accordance with statements on auditing standards (SAS)
audits in accordance with the Kansas municipal audit guide
reviews of financial statements in accordance with statements on standards for accounting and review services (SSARS)
engagements in accordance with statements on standards for attestation engagements (SSAE)
engagements in accordance with the standards of the PCAOB
attest_services_types.quote: "Attest" means providing the following services: (1) Any audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the statements on auditing standards (SAS); (2) any audit to be performed in accordance with the Kansas municipal audit guide; (3) any review of a financial statement to be performed in accordance with the statements on standards for accounting and review services (SSARS); (4) any engagement, except a compilation, to be performed in accordance with the statements on standards for attestation engagements (SSAE); and (5) any engagement to be performed in accordance with the standards of the PCAOB

compilation_services_authorized.quote: "Compilation" means providing a service to be performed in accordance with the statements on standards for accounting and review services (SSARS) or the statements on standards for attestation engagements (SSAE) the objective of which is to present in the form of financial statements, information that is the representation of management or owners, or both, without undertaking to express any assurance on the statements

education_semester_hours_required.quote: has been awarded credit by a college or university approved by the board for at least 150 semester hours, with a concentration in accounting

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: An individual whose principal place of business is not in this state having an active license to practice certified public accountancy from any state which the board or its designee has verified to be in substantial equivalence with the CPA licensure requirements of the uniform accountancy act shall be presumed to have qualifications substantially equivalent to this state's requirements and may be granted all the privileges of permit holders of this state without the need to obtain a permit issued under K.S.A. 1-310

value: consent to the personal and subject matter jurisdiction of the board
appointment of the state regulatory body which issued their licenses as the agent upon whom process may be served
cease offering or rendering professional services in this state if the license from the state of the individual's principal place of business is no longer valid
comply with the act and the board's rules and regulations
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: Any licensee of another state exercising the privilege afforded under subsection (a) and the firm which employs that licensee hereby simultaneously consent, as a condition of the grant of this privilege: (1) To the personal and subject matter jurisdiction of this board; (2) to the appointment of the state regulatory body which issued their licenses as the agent upon whom process may be served in any action or proceeding by the Kansas board against the licensee; (3) to cease offering or rendering professional services in this state individually and on behalf of the firm in the event that the license from the state of the individual's principal place of business is no longer valid; and (4) to comply with this act and the board's rules and regulations

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: An individual who has been granted practice privileges under this section who, for any client in this state, performs any of the following services: (1) Any audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the statements on auditing standards (SAS); (2) any audit to be performed in accordance with the Kansas municipal audit guide; (3) any review of a financial statement to be performed in accordance with the statements on standards for accounting and review services (SSARS); (4) any engagement, except a compilation, to be performed in accordance with the statements on standards for attestation engagements (SSAE); and (5) any engagement to be performed in accordance with the standards of the PCAOB; may only do so through a firm which has registered pursuant to K.S.A. 1-308

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: at least a simple majority of the ownership of the firm, in the terms of equity capital and voting rights of all partners, shareholders or members, belongs to the holders of valid licenses to practice as certified public accountants in some state

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: Although firms may include nonlicensee owners there shall be at least one certified public accountant who has ultimate responsibility for all the services provided by the firm and, the firm and its ownership must comply with rules and regulations promulgated by the board

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: The board may require as a condition for renewal of a firm registration that a firm that provides attest services undergo a peer review and submit evidence of such

peer_review_max_frequency_years.quote: The reviews shall occur at least once every three years

peer_review_records_privileged.quote: any reports, statements, memoranda, transcripts, findings, records, or working papers prepared and any opinions formulated, in connection with any peer review shall be privileged and shall not be subject to discovery, subpoena or other means of legal compulsion for their release to any person or entity or be admissible in evidence in any judicial or administrative proceeding

out_of_state_firm_no_office_exemption.quote: A firm which is not subject to subsection (b) may perform or offer to perform services described in K.S.A. 1-321(r), and amendments thereto, and may use the "certified public accountant," "CPA" or "CPA firm" without registering with the board only if: (1) The individuals performing such services on behalf of the firm have the qualifications described in K.S.A. 1-302b(b) and (c), and amendments thereto; (2) it performs such services through an individual with practice privileges under K.S.A. 1-322, and amendments thereto; and (3) it can lawfully perform such services in the state where such individuals with practice privileges have their principal place of business

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: each resident manager in charge of an office of the firm in this state must be a certified public accountant of this state holding a valid permit to practice

attest_report_signer_competency_requirem.quote: Any individual permit holder who signs or authorizes someone to sign the accountant's report on any attest or compilation service on behalf of the firm, shall meet the experience or competency requirement of subsection (b)

client_confidentiality_privilege.quote: No certified public accountant shall be examined through judicial process or proceedings without the consent of the client as to any communication made by the client to the certified public accountant in person or through the media of books of account and financial records, or as to advice, reports or working papers given or made thereon in the course of professional employment

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: all statements, records, schedules and memoranda, commonly known as working papers, made by a certified public accountant, or by any employee of a certified public accountant, incident to, or in the course of professional service to clients by such certified public accountant, except reports delivered to a client by such certified public accountant, shall be and remain the property of such certified public accountant in the absence of a written agreement between the certified public accountant and the client to the contrary

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: The board shall issue a certificate to a holder of a foreign designation, granted in a foreign country entitling the holder thereof to engage in the practice of certified public accountancy, provided that: (1) The foreign authority which granted the designation makes similar provision to allow a person who holds a valid certificate issued by this state to obtain such foreign authority's comparable designation

single_act_evidence_sufficient.quote: evidence of the commission of a single act prohibited by this act or the act of which this section is amendatory shall be sufficient to justify an injunction without evidence of a general course of conduct

firm_corrective_action_period_for_owners.quote: Firms which fall out of compliance with the provisions of this section due to changes in firm ownership or personnel shall take corrective action to bring the firm back into compliance as quickly as possible. The board may grant a reasonable period of time for a firm to take such corrective action

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: any firm that does not have an office in this state but performs or offers to perform attest services described in K.S.A. 1-321(d), and amendments thereto, for a client in this state
